description: This header file defines template classes and functions for managing plugin interfaces within the WPEFramework, including reference management, interface creation with retries, and builder pattern for configuration.

classes.name: PluginInterfaceRef
classes.description: A smart reference wrapper for plugin interface pointers, managing lifetime and providing move semantics.

classes.name: PluginInterfaceBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for configuring and creating plugin interface references with options like version, timeout, retry count, and interval.

methods.name: createInterface
methods.description: Creates and returns a plugin interface instance with retry logic, based on the builder configuration.

methods.name: make_unique
methods.description: A utility function to create a std::unique_ptr for a given type with forwarded arguments.
